LARGE seating rug beneath chair front legs and table but modestly reduced footprint as reference. Mix selected ceramic objects, ONE small framed artwork leaning on a shelf and a small decorative box, with lots of empty space. Respect objects fitting actual shelf heights. Keep base cupboards closed and usable. Table remains clear except small dish. No extra ornaments on desk or piano, no pot/water on piano.

Art should look like paintings with quiet brush texture, not screenshots or printed writing.
MANTEL: no more than two modest objects, centre clear, no plant-pot row, no draping vines or overgrown branches.
CUSHIONS: exactly one cushion per chair, NEVER change green chair upholstery or cover whole chair, no piles or blankets.
Lighting: natural window daylight with subtle warm lamp pools, photographic exposure consistent, KEEP wall paint colours. Real wool/linen/velvet texture and patinated frames. Natural, curated, elegant, warm and chic rather than staged clutter. No people, labels, text, watermark, grids or collage.

Over mantel: a quiet traditionally painted English river/wooded landscape, warm ivory sky, muted olive trees and brown earth, softly aged narrow gilt frame, gentle contrast.
Above piano: a restrained traditional small still-life painting of pears and an earthenware jug on muted brown background, similar narrow aged gilt frame.
